mods.description: Allow command blocks to run the /tick command!

releases.notes:
This release is for major version 26.1 through 26.1.2 (including alphas like 26.1-alpha.1). Due to [Minecraft removing symbol obfuscation in this version](https://fabricmc.net/2025/10/31/obfuscation.html), 1.21.11 and older are no longer supported. To run this mod on older Minecraft versions, use a previous release (such as [v4.0.1](https://github.com/BD103/TickLowerPerm/releases/tag/4.0.1)). This release fixes #10, where the mod would fail to load outside of the development environment due to a mistake in the mixin's invoke target.

# Features

- Updated to support 26.1 through 26.1.2

# Fixes

- Fully qualify `Commands.hasPermission()` in mixin

**Full Changelog**: [`5.0.0-alpha.1...5.0.0`](https://github.com/BD103/TickLowerPerm/compare/5.0.0-alpha.1...5.0.0)
